rounds.title: Derived search results
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Derive the visible list from the immutable source and current controls.
constraints: Search names case-insensitively without mutating the source array.
An empty query shows all users.
Render stable row identity and a single empty state when no users match.

frameworkTests.name: Round 1 · Search narrows the derived list

rounds.title: Composed filters and empty state
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Compose role, activity, and text predicates without stale results.
constraints: Apply search, role, and active-only predicates together.
Changing any control recomputes from the original user list.
Announce result-count changes through a polite status region.
When no users match, render the documented empty message and no user rows.
